comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a terminal; record swipes a magnetic-stripe card through a reader and returns it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs force-sensitive recessed probing and coordinated withdrawal; record controls card depth, orientation, direction, and continuous swipe speed.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective depinning; record requires one valid uninterrupted swipe followed by card replacement.
comparison.reason: The record tests constrained dynamic traversal, not mechanical release.
